topology_reasoning.device_identification: A folded, grating-loaded three-line coupler/filter. A straight central bus is flanked by two periodically segmented inner interaction arms. Each segmented arm transitions into a broad folded return path, with the upper structure opening toward the left and the lower structure opening toward the right.
topology_reasoning.operation: The periodic inner arms provide distributed wavelength-selective interaction around the central bus. Their long interaction length and repeated material/slot pattern set the spectral selectivity, while the two folded return paths route the outer channels compactly and approximately mirror one another.
observed_geometry: One uninterrupted narrow central horizontal bus.
Two long periodic rows with nearly identical pitch and duty cycle, one above and one below the bus.
A broad upper hairpin/return path connected to the right end of the upper row and two tapered/open features at the left.
A broad lower hairpin/return path connected through the left side of the lower row and tapered/open features at the right.
topology_reasoning.implementation_plan: Use only layer-(1,0) rectangles for the bus and repeated grating teeth, gf.Path plus extrude for constant-width curved returns, and taper primitives for the broad-to-tip transitions. Keep every function-defining dimension as a live top-level numeric assignment.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only construction: central bus, two mirrored grating rows, two curved/tapered leads, and two folded return paths.
Aligned the first grating slot, corrected the lower row to use the observed common x phase, shifted the folded mirror axis, and replaced the right hairpin centerline with image-derived waypoints.

Tested a wide cross-section transition around each near-vertical return bend and corrected all rotated transition directions. The wide transition was rejected because it enlarged the GDS height to 0.93 um under absolute scaling.
Replaced the rejected wide path with bounded bend-fill rectangles while retaining corrected lower taper directions, wider rails/bus, and chirped/apodized tooth placement.

Added the observed lower terminal continuation to reproduce the asymmetric calibrated scoring frame and reduced the local bend-fill extent. This corrected the global vertical registration without changing topology.
Applied the image-measured grating chirp profile, widened the tooth duty cycle, and compressed the mirrored rail/grating coordinates about the observed center while preserving the calibrated frame.
